main.description: Deletes a team of an organization. The caller must be an admin of the organization. Packages the team maintained keep their other maintainers.

organization.description: The organization, whose handle is a scope on this host.

name.description: One DNS label, under the rules for a profile's 'name'.

swapRecord.description: The CID the record must have now; the write fails with 'InvalidSwap' otherwise.

errors.name: InvalidSwap
errors.description: The record's current CID is not 'swapRecord'.

errors.name: TeamNotFound
errors.description: The organization has no team of that name.
